question.text: Will US and Iranian negotiators meet in person in November or December 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, after October 31, 2026 and before January 1, 2027, negotiators from Iran and the United States meet in person, anywhere in the world.
question.fine_print:
"Negotiator" is defined as any official or envoy who has authorization to negotiate on behalf of their government.

"In person" means at least one negotiator on behalf of the US executive branch and at least one negotiator on behalf of Iran's national government occupying the same venue. Interpreters or mediators are permitted, including if they are shuttling between the two sides (thus the meeting need not be face-to-face to count). 

In order to count, the meeting must be reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) as any talks or negotiations on US-Iran issues (such as a ceasefire, Iran's nuclear program, the status of the Strait of Hormuz, or sanctions).

***
This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46314) which opened on 2026-10-26 17:00:00. This question will resolve based on the resolution criteria and fine print of the linked original question. However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. Additionally, if the original question's resolution could have been known before this question opened, then this question will be annulled.

Quick update: I've collected the latest news on the Doha talks and the Vance letter. Here's the summary.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question has no data series behind it. It resolves on credible reporting of US and Iranian negotiators at the same venue between Nov 1 and Dec 31, 2026. Meetings with mediators shuttling between the two teams count. I did not fetch the Metaculus page (post 46314). As of Nov 3, I found no credible report of such a meeting after Oct 31.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The Oct 29 to Nov 1 Doha round was Iran talking with Qatari mediators only. No report I found puts US negotiators in Doha.
- 2026-11-01: The Yeshiva World, citing Reuters, said the talks ran "through regular coordination with Washington." It did not report any US presence. [YWN](https://www.theyeshivaworld.com/news/israel-news/2617451/iran-showdown-negotiators-continue-doha-talks-as-tehran-confirms-receiving-letter-from-vice-president-vance.html)
- 2026-11-01: Araghchi said there were no plans to meet the US during the Iranian delegation's stay in Doha. [Okaz](https://www.okaz.com.sa/politics/na/2273465); [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/1/mediators-continue-us-iran-negotiations-amid-war-rhetoric-what-we-know)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-03: Rezaei said the US reply to Iran's demands "was not convincing." He said Washington must answer Iran's seven conditions "completely and explicitly." [Clash Report](https://clashreport.com/world/articles/rezaei-says-us-reply-to-iran-s-demands-was-not-convincing-must-be-explicit-mj32i6yfrj)

[HNGN](https://www.hngn.com/articles/273662/20261103/trump-says-not-hurry-iran-awaits-answer-2-day-hormuz-plan.htm); [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/international/6189852-iran-offers-strait-hormuz-opening/)
- 2026-10-31: Rezaei said the US tone had "completely changed." His conditions before any nuclear talks: lift the naval blockade, issue oil waivers, unfreeze assets, stop fighting on all fronts including Lebanon, and recognize an Iran-Oman arrangement for the strait. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/31/iran-fm-says-us-outreach-a-positive-step-as-delegation-in-qatar-for-talks); [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/01/iran-weighs-vance-letter-amid-renewed-doha-peace-push/)

It also said Iran must name negotiators authorized to discuss the nuclear file. On Oct 28 Trump framed the outreach as being about medical supplies. [Iran International](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202610307228); [IranWire](https://iranwire.com/en/features/159665-iran-reviews-vance-negotiation-proposal-sent-via-qatari-mediators/)

## 4. Base rates
- Since the war began on Feb 28, there have been four in-person rounds in about 8 months, per the question background: Apr 11-12, Jun 21-28, Jul 1-2 and Sep 22. That is roughly one every 2 months, with gaps of about 2.3, 0.1 and 2.7 months.
- Of the two-month windows Mar-Apr, May-Jun, Jul-Aug and Sep-Oct, all four contained a meeting. Rolling windows like Aug-Sep and Oct-Nov (so far) show gaps of up to about 2.5 months.
- There was precedent for a visit that fell short: in late June, Witkoff and Kushner went to Doha but "skipped" meeting Iranian negotiators directly. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/30/are-us-and-iranian-negotiators-meeting-in-doha-what-we-know-about-talks); [Spokesman](https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2026/jun/30/us-says-witkoff-kushner-had-positive-talks-in-doha/)
- Under this question's fine print, a same-venue meeting with Qatari shuttling (like UNGA in September) would count.

## 5. Other forecasts (fetched 2026-11-03)
- Kalshi, "U.S.-Iran senior-level meeting": 40% before Jan 1, 2027 and 33% before Dec 1. This is close to the question, but "senior-level" may be a stricter bar than "any authorized negotiator."

- Polymarket, "Where will the next meeting take place": "No meeting by Dec 31" is at 51.5%. Leading venues are Qatar (16%) and Switzerland (5.5%).
- Kalshi, US-Iran nuclear deal before Jan 1, 2027: 10%.
- Polymarket, oil sanctions relief by Dec 31: 38.5%.
- I could not see the current Metaculus community forecast.

## 6. Upcoming events
- 2026-11-03: US midterm elections. Strike options are reportedly being presented to Trump after the vote. [HNGN](https://www.hngn.com/articles/273662/20261103/trump-says-not-hurry-iran-awaits-answer-2-day-hormuz-plan.htm)
- Still pending:
  - Rezaei's formal reply to the Vance letter.
  - The outcome of the Qatari mediators' Tehran visit (from Nov 2).
  - A possible "follow-up meeting" in Doha or Istanbul.
- 2026-11-10 to 11: Witkoff is due at US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, which is a demand on his time but also puts him in the region. [Asia-Plus](https://asiaplus.news/en/2026/11/03/the-us-russia-and-ukraine-to-hold-new-round-of-talks-in-abu-dhabi-on-november-10-11/)
- Risks: renewed US or Israeli strikes after the midterms could derail talks or create pressure to talk. Iran's precondition that the blockade be lifted before nuclear talks is the main obstacle.
- I found no scheduled US-Iran meeting date as of Nov 3.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 8 weeks remain, Nov 1 to Dec 31, 2026, with resolution around Jan 1, 2027. For Yes, credible sources must report that at least one authorized US executive-branch negotiator and one authorized Iranian negotiator were at the same venue holding talks on US-Iran issues. Mediator shuttling counts.

(b) The status quo is No. As of Nov 3 no meeting is scheduled. The Oct 29 to Nov 1 Doha round was Iran meeting Qatari mediators only, and Araghchi said there were no plans to meet the US there.

(c) Base rate: there have been four in-person rounds in about 8 months of war, roughly one every 2 months. Every calendar two-month block so far contained one, but gaps of up to about 2.7 months occurred. A Poisson rate of about 0.5 per month over 2 months gives about 63%. Since the last meeting was Sep 22, a gap-based estimate puts it nearer 55-60%.

(d) Evidence for Yes:
- Oct 29: Vance's letter offered a meeting, with Istanbul or Doha as venues.
- Oct 31: Rezaei said the US tone had "completely changed."
- Nov 2: A draft deal is circulating, Qatari mediators were due in Tehran, and a follow-up meeting is "possible."
- Nov 3: The NYT reported direct talks could start "as early as this week" in Qatar or Turkey.
- Trump, Vance and Witkoff reportedly lean toward diplomacy.
- Witkoff will be in Abu Dhabi on Nov 10-11, which puts him in the region.
- This question's bar (same venue, shuttling allowed) is lower than the markets' "senior-level" bar.

Evidence for No:
- Nov 3: Rezaei called the US reply "not convincing" and demanded explicit answers to Iran's seven conditions.
- Overnight Nov 2-3: US strikes near Hormuz.
- Strike options are going to Trump after the midterms, and Netanyahu is pushing for strikes.
- Iran wants the blockade lifted before nuclear talks.
- Precedent: in late June, Witkoff and Kushner were in Doha but skipped meeting the Iranians.

(e) No scenario: Iran's preconditions stall the process. After the midterms Trump authorizes broader strikes, and Iran suspends contact except through written Qatari channels through December.

Yes scenario: Rezaei answers the Vance letter, and in mid-to-late November Witkoff and Kushner meet Araghchi in Doha or Istanbul, with Qatar shuttling. That is enough to resolve Yes.

(f) I start from a base rate of about 58%. The markets on similar but stricter questions sit at 40% (Kalshi) and 47.5% (Polymarket). These are fairly liquid and close in scope, but this question's lower bar (shuttling at the same venue counts) justifies a few points above them. The escalation risk after the midterms pulls me down from the base rate. I land slightly above the market average.

Probability: 52%

(a) About 2 months remain, Nov 1 to Dec 31, 2026, and the outcome is known by about Jan 1, 2027. For Yes, credible sources must report that at least one authorized US executive-branch negotiator and at least one authorized Iranian negotiator were at the same venue for talks on US-Iran issues.
